invariants: rho, tau, q_dec, kappa, k_f*tau, all runtime_norm ratios, A2 conditioning vector unchanged — runner asserts the moved pin set is exactly {alpha, lam} for levels 1-2
n_rationale: Stage 4 estimand = independent shape-effect reproduction, not the Stage 3 equivalence precision; n=400 (kill-screen grade) is sealed separately and NOT inherited from the Stage 3 n=650

verdict_rules.primary_direction: dp(level2 vs level0) negative in ALL 6 cells (paired CI95 upper < 0 per cell)
verdict_rules.primary_material: pooled |dp(level2 vs level0)| >= 0.20 — the sealed promotion-candidate threshold (sign-consistent |dp|>0.20)
verdict_rules.secondary_dose: pooled dp(level1) lies between 0 and dp(level2) — reported as ordering cross-check, not gating
verdict_rules.POSITIVE: direction AND material -> (chi, eta, lam) re-registration path, C045 candidate PARTIAL_3D; Stage 3 cell lattice is sealed only AFTER this verdict (lambda slice choice enters the contract)
verdict_rules.NEGATIVE: direction or material fails -> lambda NOT independently reproducing; the Stage 1 R-rho-DOM effect is recorded as an unresolved bundle (no auto-promotion, sealed rule)

sharding: by scenario: s in [0, 2400), cell = s // 400; 3 levels per scenario; 8 shards ~25 min
